component.name: Blackthorn Launcher
component.summary: Launcher for the Blackthorn Dark Age of Camelot server

description.p: The Blackthorn Launcher downloads and patches the Dark Age of Camelot game client, manages server connections, and provides an in-game UI overlay for the Blackthorn private server.

The launcher needs access to the game client directory chosen by the user in its settings. By default it expects Wine prefixes under the home directory. Users with a game installation elsewhere can grant access with:
